Sensitive But Unclassified-Limited Official Use Only U.S. Department of Justice Federal Bureau of Prisons Field Acquisition Office On Behalf Of Federal Correctional Institution Ray Brook

S UBJECT:

August 06, 2026

MEMORANDUM FOR PROCUREMENT FILE

FCI Ray Brook Emergency Airflight Restricted Competition-Unusual and compelling urgency IAW RFO 12.102(a)

REQ

UIRING AGENCY: DOJ/Bureau of Prisons, FCI Ray Brook, NY

R

FO 12.102(a) For acquisitions valued at or below the simplified acquisition threshold (SAT), document the decision that only one source is available and the basis for the decision.

F ederal Correctional Institution (FCI) Ray Brook, located in Ray Brook, NY, requires an emergency medical flight to transfer an inmate. The inmate was transported to the emergency department at Adirondack Health for a medical emergency, where they determined further medical treatment was needed that could not be conducted at Adirondack Health. The inmate required a helicopter transfer to Albany Medical. Due to the medical emergency, it was not reasonable to compete this requirement. In stances of medical emergencies do not allow time for regular procurement methods when life and safety are at risk. It was inherent that the helicopter transfer immediately occur for the inmate. Competition requirements could not be met due to the unusual and compelling urgency.

T he value of this acquisition is estimated to be $64,111.45. The price is determined to be fair and reasonable based on industry standards.

R estricting competition and awarding to Rocky Mountain Holdings is in the best interest of the Government and is consistent with the streamlined acquisition procedures of the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul found at Part 12-Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services, 12.102(a) Restricting Competition.

C ertification: All information within this memo is complete and to the best of my knowledge.

L aurel Karnes Contracting Officer Federal Bureau of Prisons Field Acquisition Office Oversight, Assistance, and Training Section (OATS)-East-NER
